components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.6rem;padding:0 1.6rem;height:66px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.55),rgba(252,241,218,.3)),rgba(252,241,218,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(87,15,29,.12),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-family:Montserrat,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-logo{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.5rem;color:#6F2B34;margin-right:auto}.ds-logo i{font-weight:600}.ds-nav a{position:relative;text-decoration:none;color:#6F2B34;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem}.ds-nav a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-4px;height:2px;background:#6F2B34;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .22s}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a.on::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #6F2B34;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}

narrative.overview: A dark wine room that blooms into light. The page opens in wine, a bud glows and a circle of cream floods the page; everything after is colour-blocked rooms with petal-scalloped edges. Warm, candid, unhurried, with poster-like playfulness. Rejects the corporate-charity template.
keyCharacteristics: Cream page, wine ink; dark wine rooms for hero, statement, band and footer.
Playfair Display bold with italic accents; Montserrat for body.
CSS-first, scroll-linked motion that respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: The page is cream; dark wine is a room you enter, never the default surface.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Wine or mulberry ink on light, cream with petal or rose accents on dark. Never pure black or white.

rules.name: The Tint-Don't-Gray Rule
rules.body: Shadows, borders and overlays are tinted from wine or mulberry.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: Each major headline may carry one italic accent word; never italicise paragraphs.

rules.name: The Balanced Headline Rule
rules.body: Headings use text-wrap: balance, body copy text-wrap: pretty.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a colour block or scalloped edge before a shadow.

rules.name: The Glass-Once Rule
rules.body: Frosted blur is reserved for the floating header.

dos: Keep the page cream and enter wine rooms deliberately.
Use mulberry for headings and primary buttons, wine for body text.
End major headlines with one italic Playfair accent word.
Separate sections with colour blocks and scalloped edges.
Use full pills for controls and 32 to 48px radii for cards.
Keep motion transform/opacity only, with a plain fallback and a gentle reduced-motion path.
Keep touch targets at 44px+, inputs at 16px+, focus visible.
donts: Don't use the corporate-charity template: stock-photo hero, donate button, fabricated impact.
Don't use pure black, pure white or neutral-gray shadows.
Don't add glass panels beyond the header, or heavy shadows first.
Don't add gradient text or side-stripe borders; the closing's tile-filled headline is the one exception.
Don't italicise body paragraphs or set display type in Montserrat.
Don't swap the palette or fonts.
